tooltips.params: How this action runs. Optional dynamic values fill a setting automatically when the step runs.
tooltips.formula: Script for “Run formula” actions. You can update the target, move steps, or send events — unsafe operations are blocked.
tooltips.conditionFormula: Advanced true/false formula. When filled, it replaces the visual Run if conditions without deleting them.
tooltips.conditionsGroup: Visual target-record conditions. Add nested AND/OR groups. The action is skipped when they do not match.
tooltips.maxRetries: How many times to retry this action (0–5) if it fails. Does not restart the whole connection.
tooltips.continueOnError: If on, run the next actions after a failure. If off, stop here.
tooltips.trigger: Run this action when the record enters or leaves this step.
tooltips.order: Lower numbers run first inside the same step.

messages.useFormulaField: Write the script in the Formula field above. Settings here are optional.
messages.paramFormulasHint: Optional: fill a setting from the target record when the step runs (for example the owner). Workspace is never overwritten.
messages.platformActionHint: Platform action — needs platform access / superadmin.
messages.updateTargetFieldsHint: Choose a standard field or a Custom Field. Use fx for a value computed when the step runs. Other custom values stay; only what you set here changes.
messages.createRecordHint: Creates a record stamped with this journey’s workspace (tenant) and teams. Field allow-list applies.
messages.createRelatedRecordHint: Creates a related record on the target and stamps tenant + teams. Foreign type comes from the link.
messages.linkRecordHint: Links only when both sides belong to this workspace.
messages.applyAssignmentRuleHint: Routes ownership inside a workspace team only. Report-based rules are blocked.
messages.sendHttpRequestHint: URL must match a platform allow-list prefix. Private IPs and localhost are blocked.
messages.makeFollowedHint: Only users that belong to this workspace can be added as followers.
messages.sendEmailAccountHint: Pick a Group or Personal email account that belongs to this workspace. System SMTP is never used.
messages.sendEmailTemplateHint: Active Email Templates only. Pick a template, then use Test / render against a sample contact (placeholders resolved, no send). Subject/body overrides apply when the template leaves them empty. With empty To, sends one message to each non-opted-out / non-invalid email on the target (primary + secondary).
messages.sendWhatsAppMessageHint: Pick any active WhatsApp inbox (WAHA QR, Cloud API, or Coexistence). Optional fallback Meta template is used only when Cloud session window is closed. With empty phone, sends to every sendable number on the target (phone fields + WhatsApp channel identities), like WhatsApp Campaign.
messages.sendWhatsAppTemplateHint: Cloud API / Coexistence inbox only. Templates are loaded from the selected inbox Meta account (APPROVED). Map parameters with Handlebars like WhatsApp Campaign. Use Test / render to preview against a contact without sending. With empty phone, sends the template to every sendable number on the target.
messages.whatsappTemplatePickTarget: Pick a sample contact to render against.
messages.emailTemplatePickTarget: Pick a sample contact to render against.
messages.emailTemplateRenderFailed: Failed to render email template preview.
messages.expressionHint: Expression mode (fx): type text and insert field chips. Runs as a restricted formula when the step executes.
messages.expressionPlaceholder: Type text, or + to insert a field…
messages.expressionPreviewEmpty: will evaluate when the step runs
messages.linkExpressionHint: Turn on fx to resolve this link from a formula (e.g. entity\attribute('assignedUserId')).
messages.orphanParamFormulasHint: Dynamic keys not shown above (from older configs or advanced JSON).
messages.docAttrName: Full display name of the target record.
messages.docAttrEmail: Primary email address on the target record.
messages.docAttrPhone: Primary phone number on the target record.
messages.docAttrOwner: Assigned user id — use for ownership / routing.
messages.docAttrId: Internal id of the target record.
messages.docVarStage: Id of the current stage when the action runs.
messages.docHelperIfEmpty: Return the email when present, otherwise an empty string.
messages.docHelperCustomField: Read a key from the Monostax customFields bag.
messages.docHelperConcat: Build a full name from first + last.
messages.docFnConcatenate: Join text and dynamic values into one string.
messages.docFnIfThenElse: If condition is truthy, return the second argument; otherwise the third.
messages.docFnContains: True when the haystack text contains the needle.
messages.docFnNumberFormat: Format a number with fixed decimals.
messages.docFnObjectGet: Read a key from an object (e.g. customFields bag).
messages.docFnAttribute: Read a field from the target record.
messages.docFnEmpty: True when the value is empty/null.
messages.conditionsEmpty: No conditions. This action always runs.
messages.conditionsHint: Choose target fields and combine rules with nested AND/OR groups.
messages.conditionValueFormulaHint: Use fx when an expected value must be calculated at runtime.
messages.conditionFormulaOverride: The advanced formula is filled and overrides these visual conditions.

conditionOperators.greaterThanOrEquals: is greater than or equal to
conditionOperators.lessThanOrEquals: is less than or equal to
